scope: Dissected tissue samples were lysed, reduced and alkylated using the Sample Preparation by Easy Extraction and Digestion (SPEED) procedure.

Microdissected tissue samples were incubated in lysis buffer (6M guanidine hydrochloride, 5mM tris(2-carboxyethyl)phosphine, 10mM chloroacetamide and 100mM Tris-HCl in 50mM ammonium bicarbonate) for 10 minutes at 99°C with mixing at 750RPM.
Tissue lysates were then sonicated with 20mg protein extraction beads (Diagenode) using a Bioruptor Plus (Diagenode) for 20 cycles with on/off pulses of 30 seconds.
